description: 112年8月雲林縣液化石油氣消防安全檢查及違規取締統計 [fuel stations and oil and fire, police and emergency services] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 雲林縣消防局. 凡雲林縣液化石油氣分銷商、分裝場、容器檢驗場、容器儲存場所及串接使用場所消防安全設備之查察或違反「公共危險物品及可燃性高壓氣體設置標準暨安全管理辦法」有關液化石油氣部分之安全管理及查察取締事項，均為統計對象. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal lists 14 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 雲林縣消防局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-10-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
